C1_dependencies.name: LorentzGroup.IsOrthochronous
C1_dependencies.content:
/-- A Lorentz transformation is `orthochronous` if its `0 0` element is non-negative. -/
def IsOrthochronous : Prop := 0 ≤ Λ.1 (Sum.inl 0) (Sum.inl 0)
C1_dependencies.compilationAlias:

C1_dependencies.name: LorentzGroup.IsProper
C1_dependencies.content:
/-- A Lorentz Matrix is proper if its determinant is 1. -/
@[simp]
def IsProper (Λ : LorentzGroup d) : Prop := Λ.1.det = 1
